title: Mastercard Launches Quantum Advisory Practice with QIZ Security and Releases PQC Readiness Whitepaper - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Mastercard (NYSE: MA), through its Advisors and Transformation division, has launched a dedicated Quantum Advisory Practice accompanied by a whitepaper titled Quantum Computing and Financial Services outlining post-quantum cryptography (PQC) transition strategies for banks, acquirers, payment service providers, and fintechs. Positioned around a 2029–2030 planning horizon and aligned with G7 Cyber Expert Group and Financial Services Information Sharing and Analysis Center (FS-ISAC) guidance, the initiative addresses immediate “harvest now, decrypt later” (HNDL) exposure across long-lived financial and customer datasets.

To execute the advisory offering, Mastercard is partnering with cryptography management provider QIZ Security, which joins the practice to support automated cryptographic asset discovery, data-longevity risk registers, phased remediation roadmaps, cryptographic agility guardrails, and board-level reporting frameworks. Alongside its PQC readiness services, Mastercard highlighted ongoing quantum research and development with Oxford Quantum Circuits (OQC), including a hybrid quantum-classical pilot focused on financial fraud protection.
